policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: Admin-target Canopy User Settings actor/storage-isolation regressions exercise one previously uncovered core line while leaving the instrumented core scope unchanged. The reviewed high-water advances from 2325/2666 (87.209%) to 2326/2666 (87.247%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 full-suite coverage runs on 2026-07-26 each passed all 1526 tests across 218 files and reproduced exactly 2326/2666. Retaining the one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2325/2666 (87.209%), equal to the prior reviewed high-water and stricter than its 2324/2666 tolerated floor (87.172%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The elevated admin-target user-settings API adds 140 instrumented lines (28605→28745) for policy enforcement, target resolution, bounded payloads, strong If-Match revisions, conflicts, quarantine, and shared-store semantics. Controller and payload regressions add 121 covered lines (20200→20321), raising the reviewed high-water from 70.617% to 70.694%. Two clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-26 each passed all 1814 tests across the complete assembly and reproduced exactly 20321/28745. Retaining the evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 20316/28745 (70.677%), stricter than both the prior 20200/28605 high-water (70.617%) and its 20195/28605 tolerated floor (70.600%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
